superflowHeadline: Marker.io is a bug reporting tool. Superflow is a bug reporting tool + a team.
superflowBody: The team is AI agents, built from your QA checklist. They check every site change and pin what they find. Your team decides. Your client approves from a link.
superflowBestFor: agencies where a senior person still checks every site by hand.

entries.name: BugHerd
entries.bestFor: agencies that want feedback pinned right on the live page.
entries.standout: element pins with browser, OS, and screen size attached automatically.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue. No AI review layer. A formal client approval flow: not yet verified. Pricing from $50 per month (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: pins live on the page. Marker.io captures a screenshot and files it into your tracker instead. Same premise, a person finds every mistake.

entries.name: Usersnap
entries.limits: Product feedback, not agency client review. Human-found only. Pricing: not yet verified.
entries.vsAnchor: built for in-product user feedback and surveys. Less built for developer handoff into a tracker.

entries.name: Pastel
entries.limits: Proxy-based review, not the live site: not yet verified. Light workflow. Human-found only. Pricing: not yet verified.
entries.vsAnchor: faster to start, lighter workflow. Tracker integrations and technical capture like Marker.io's console logs and session replay: not yet verified.

entries.name: Ruttl
entries.bestFor: the closest BugHerd-like experience on a budget.
entries.limits: Same premise: people find, the tool records. Full feature set and pricing: not yet verified.
entries.vsAnchor: suggest-edits mode on live pages, lighter than Marker.io's ticket-and-tracker workflow. Full feature set: not yet verified.

stayHeading: The sixth option: stay on Marker.io
stayBody: Feedback becomes a ticket in the tracker your team already runs, and status syncs back on the Team plan. Console logs, network requests, and session replay attach to reports on the Team plan and up. Reporters are free and unlimited, no account needed (verified July 2026).
stayLine: If a careful human pass, filed into the tracker you already run, works for your team, stay.

faq.question: Which is the best Marker.io alternative?
faq.answer: Depends which criterion fails you. If it's the checking hours, Superflow, the only one where the answer is a team, not a tool.

faq.question: Is Superflow just Marker.io with AI?
faq.answer: No. Agents find the mistakes; a person makes every call.

faq.question: Can clients comment without an account?
faq.answer: On several, Marker.io included, where reporters submit free with no account. In Superflow the client's yes is a recorded approval, not a comment.

faq.question: What does switching cost?
faq.answer: An afternoon. One snippet, or one click on Webflow, WordPress, GTM. Open projects finish where they are.
